# CLIP STUDIO PAINT

> A comprehensive digital art and creative software platform supporting illustration, manga, animation, and design across multiple platforms.

CLIP STUDIO PAINT is a professional-grade creative application developed by Celsys that enables artists to create digital illustrations, manga, comics, animations, and graphic designs. The site provides product information, feature overviews, downloads, certification programs, and licensing options across Windows, macOS, iPad, Android, and other platforms.

## Key Topics

- CLIP STUDIO PAINT (Pro/EX editions)
- Digital art and illustration
- Manga and comic creation
- Animation production
- Cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, iPad, Android)
- Graphic design tools
- Character illustration
- Digital painting (watercolor, oil painting)
- CLIP STUDIO ASSETS
- CLIP STUDIO TABMATE
- Creator certification
- Volume licensing
- Free trial
- Brush customization
- Multi-platform synchronization
